notes: Kernel setup excluded. Dense/sparse have identical samples, writes and full-buffer checksum consumption. Affine avoids trajectories. Retained validation is five runs, not the full batch. Overlapping phases do not sum to total search. No global optimum or universal speedup claim.

phases.name: dense_sampled_kernel
phases.scope: all candidates, 120 dense incidence/Euler steps, full trajectory writes and consumption
phases.allocation_scope: prebuilt topology/numeric inputs and reusable workspace; no allocation instrumentation

phases.name: sparse_sampled_kernel
phases.scope: same samples/outputs/consumption as dense; sparse edge updates
phases.allocation_scope: same preallocation as dense; no allocation instrumentation

phases.name: affine_screen_kernel
phases.scope: actual production endpoint/storage/shared-destination/cost screen; no sampled trajectories or final validation
phases.allocation_scope: prepared production topology/candidate buffers/workspace; no allocation instrumentation

phases.name: reference_validate_retained
phases.scope: independent validate() on retained dense runs; excludes compile/simulate
phases.allocation_scope: validator map/report allocations included

phases.name: public_search_total
phases.scope: evaluate_candidates(): preparation, bounds, screen, ranking, retained compile/dense simulation/validation and result materialization
phases.allocation_scope: all public API allocations and destruction included
